data.title: BDR Outreach - Monterrey Steel Logistics SA

sentences.text: Hello Ricardo, thank you for taking the time to discuss logistics financing for your flatbed fleet.

Hello Sarah. We operate 24 flatbed units transporting industrial steel coils from Monterrey to San Antonio and Houston. Our payment terms with automotive tier-1 suppliers are 60 to 90 days, which creates cash flow strain during fuel and toll cycles.
Understood. Our commercial factoring program provides same-day advances on verified bills of lading with non-recourse credit protection.
That is exactly what we need. If your advance rate is at 88% or higher, we can commit 40 monthly loads immediately.
